subject.title: Slack thread replies can be generated but not delivered after origin tuple is lost

question: Is the current sanitized live evidence enough to sponsor a Slack delivery-state fix now, or should implementation wait for a reduced QA flow that ties one source message to origin tuple, persisted final, missing receipt, and cleanup/recovery completion?
rationale: The user-visible bug is plausible and supported by live reports, but current source already has multiple partial mechanisms and the related fail-closed Slack thread proposal was rejected as the wrong contract without stronger proof.

options.title: Wait for reduced proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the reduced Slack QA/event sequence before queueing a focused repair.

options.title: Sponsor diagnostics first
options.body: Allow a narrow diagnostic-only change that records generated-final/no-receipt state without changing delivery or retry behavior yet.

options.title: Fold into broad delivery contract
options.body: Move the remaining work under the broader durable final delivery contract and keep this issue as Slack-specific evidence.

recommendation.title: Wait for reduced proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the reduced Slack QA/event sequence before queueing a focused repair.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete provided the current maintainer triage direction and made the related Slack API contract decision.
